role: Query filter and health-report data structures for knowledge graph introspection.
detail: Defines four frozen (immutable) Pydantic models for querying the Co-Being knowledge graph. TemporalWindow models a half-open time interval [start, end) for filtering temporal fields. NodeFilter provides optional AND-combined criteria: node_type (string), schema_level (SchemaLevel enum), temporal_window (TemporalWindow), min_confidence (0.0-1.0). EdgeFilter similarly filters edges by edge_type, source_node_id, target_node_id, and min_confidence (0.0-1.0), all optional with AND semantics. SchemaHealthReport is a point-in-time snapshot of graph health (six non-negative counts/ratios: total_instance_count, total_type_count, type_coverage_ratio [0.0-1.0], avg_confidence [0.0-1.0], pending_proposal_count, orphan_node_count) consumed by Layer 4 reasoning to trigger schema-evolution proposals. All models use ConfigDict(frozen=True) and Pydantic Field validators (ge/le) for immutability and range enforcement.
